description:
### ✨ New Features

* **Discord:** Add `Message highlights` patch ([#60](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/60))
* **Discord - Message highlights:** Change the left bar width and highlight colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages, with a live chat preview and any-color picker ([#60](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/60))
* **Discord:** Add `Custom themes` patch ([#57](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/57))
* **Discord - Custom themes:** Install Revenge and Vendetta color themes from a link, switch between them and show their chat wallpaper ([#57](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/57))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Venus button on profile bar:** Fixed the first tap after restarting opening Account settings or a black screen instead of Venus settings ([#58](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/58))
* **Discord - Account switcher:** Fixed adding a sixth account removing one of your saved accounts instead of keeping up to 50 ([#59](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/59))
* **Discord - Spaces in channel names:** Fixed forum, media, directory and app channels and channel mentions still showing dashes instead of spaces
* **Discord - Double-tap to reply:** Fixed double-tapping replying in channels where you can't reply, and Discord still showing its double-tap to react tips
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed turning it off not bringing back Discord's real 2000 or 4000 character limit until restart
* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed long messages losing text-to-speech and mention settings, and waiting out slowmode even when you can bypass it
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed servers you're previewing, guest servers, servers with unread events and DMs past the first 20 staying unread
* **Discord - User activity notifications:** Fixed no notice showing when a watched person came online for the first time since Discord opened
* **Discord - Send audio as voice messages:** Fixed audio sent in announcement channels or as a scheduled message not becoming a voice message

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Venus settings:** Redesign every option page with a status card, Discord's row icons and live previews of what each feature changes
* **Discord - Venus settings:** Show every Venus pop-up message with an icon, like Discord's own, and translate every new settings text
* **Discord - User activity notifications:** Pick All friends or People I pick with one switch, with avatars and status dots for each person
* **Discord - User and server reviews:** Retry a failed load with a real button, and say Signed in to ReviewDB after signing in

### ⚡ Performance Improvements

* **Discord - Pastel name colors:** Skip copying a message on every scroll frame when its colors didn't change
* **Discord - Send audio as voice messages:** Convert audio with less memory and without waiting between decoder steps

patches.name: Account switcher
patches.description: Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.

patches.name: Complete Quests automatically
patches.description: Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. You still claim rewards. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches.name: Copy profile bios
patches.description: Hold a bio to select and copy its text. Links still work.

patches.name: Custom themes
patches.description: Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.

patches.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable crash reporting
patches.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable install attribution
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Double-tap to reply
patches.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Favourite any image or video
patches.description: Star any image or video in the media viewer to keep it in your GIF favourites.

patches.name: Fix unknown mentions
patches.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Hide the Quests banner
patches.description: Removes the Quest promotion above your profile bar. Quests still work.

patches.name: Hide the call button
patches.description: Removes Call from people's profiles. Message fills the space.

patches.name: Hide the gift button
patches.description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches.name: Jump to first message
patches.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches.name: Message highlights
patches.description: Change the left bar thickness and highlight colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches.name: Pastel name colors
patches.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel color, always the same for each person.

patches.name: Read all button
patches.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches.description: Stickers and emojis you'd need Nitro for are sent as a link, which shows up in chat as the sticker or emoji image.

patches.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches.description: An audio file sent on its own becomes a real voice message, with a waveform. Needs Android 10 or newer.

patches.name: Send long messages
patches.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches.name: Show device indicators
patches.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches.description: Each photo and video in the attachment picker shows its size.

patches.name: Show hidden channels
patches.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches.name: Spaces in channel names
patches.description: Shows "general chat" instead of "general-chat". Only changes how names look.

patches.name: Translate messages
patches.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches.description: Your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker.

patches.name: Use your phone's font
patches.description: Replaces Discord's font (gg sans) with your phone's, everywhere. Needs Android 9 or newer.

patches.name: User activity notifications
patches.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches.name: User and server reviews
patches.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches.name: Venus settings
patches.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

release_notes:
## [1.9.0](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/compare/v1.8.0...v1.9.0) (2026-10-13)

### ✨ New Features

* **Discord:** Add `ValidUser` patch
* **Discord - ValidUser:** Fix @unknown-user mentions automatically, with no extra taps
* **Discord:** Add `Profile bar settings button` patch
* **Discord - Profile bar settings button:** Open Venus settings from a button next to the notifications bell
* **Discord:** Add `Split Large Messages` patch
* **Discord - Split Large Messages:** Send messages over the limit as several, keeping code blocks closed
* **Discord:** Add `Translate messages` patch
* **Discord - Translate messages:** Show messages in other languages translated into your language, newest first
* **Discord - Translate messages:** Keep translations on your phone, so reopened chats show them at once

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Pastelize:** Fixed Color message text leaving the quoted message in a reply uncolored instead of using that author's pastel color ([#45](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/45))

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Venus settings:** Every feature starts off, so nothing changes until you turn it on
